about: COMMON test data for the pipeline (jobs 4-5): one row per component, in the component's main table (components without tables have none). Loaded after the fresh install (4.2b), into the last release (5.3) and again after the upgrade (5.7, insert + update). Never kept in the database between runs. Every other table is listed in no_data. Before adding a row, check every constraint of its table in db/deploy/install (CREATE TABLE and every later ADD_CONSTRAINT / ALTER).

no_data.XXFND_SCHEMA_RELEASES: the release record: written by the install / upgrade itself (XXFND_DDL_PKG.MARK_RELEASE) - test rows would hide a missing release step
no_data.XXFND_DROPPED_OBJECTS: written only by XXFND_DDL_PKG.DROP_OBJECT; no primary key
no_data.XXFND_APPLICATION_FUNCTIONS: minimal test data: one row per component, in its main table only
